A data center posts a security guard at its main entrance. Which control category BEST describes the guard?
A guard is a physical control because it protects facilities and people through tangible means. Technical controls are implemented in systems and software.
A file server computes a SHA-256 hash of a configuration file every night and compares it with the previous value. Which part of the CIA triad is being verified?
Hash comparison detects unauthorized changes to data, which is integrity. Hashing does not hide content, so it does not address confidentiality.
A router logs every command that an administrator types during a session. Which AAA function does this represent?
Accounting records what a user did and when. Authentication proves identity and authorization determines permitted actions.
Which TWO of the following are asymmetric cryptographic algorithms?
RSA and ECC use public/private key pairs. AES and 3DES are symmetric ciphers and SHA-256 is a hashing algorithm.
An organization must encrypt very large volumes of data at rest with minimal performance impact. Which approach is BEST?
Symmetric algorithms are much faster than asymmetric ones for bulk data. Hashing is one-way and cannot be reversed to recover the data.
Two systems must establish a shared session key over an untrusted network so that a later compromise of a long-term private key does not expose past sessions. Which should be used?
Ephemeral Diffie-Hellman generates a fresh key per session, giving perfect forward secrecy. Static RSA key transport exposes past sessions if the private key is later stolen.
An administrator needs to obtain a certificate for a new web server. What must the administrator submit to the certificate authority?
A CSR contains the public key and identity details to be signed by the CA. The private key must never leave the server.
A security researcher conceals a message inside the pixel data of a JPEG image so that observers do not realize a message exists. Which technique is this?
Steganography hides the existence of data within another file. Encryption protects content but does not hide that a message exists.
A certificate authority needs a dedicated, tamper-resistant appliance to generate and store its root private keys. Which device is BEST?
Trusted platform module (TPM) on a laptop
An HSM is a purpose-built, tamper-resistant device for protecting and using cryptographic keys at scale. A TPM is tied to a single endpoint.
An employee in accounts payable can both add new vendors and approve payments to them. Which security principle is MOST directly violated?
Separation of duties splits critical tasks among people to prevent fraud. Least privilege concerns the amount of access, though it is related.
A security team deploys an unused server with fake data to lure attackers and study their techniques. What is this?
A honeypot is a decoy system designed to attract and observe attackers. A jump server is a legitimate hardened administrative gateway.
A switch port receives frames carrying two stacked 802.1Q tags, and the inner tag causes traffic to reach a VLAN the attacker's port is not assigned to. Which attack is this?
Double tagging is a classic VLAN hopping technique that exploits the native VLAN. MAC flooding targets the CAM table instead.
Which TWO actions help prevent VLAN hopping?
Increase the MAC address aging timer
Disable trunk negotiation (DTP) on user-facing ports
Change the native VLAN to an unused VLAN
Statically setting access ports and moving the native VLAN away from user VLANs blocks switch spoofing and double tagging. DHCP snooping and QoS do not address trunk behavior.
A switch suddenly begins forwarding unicast traffic out of every port, and logs show thousands of new source MAC addresses on a single access port. Which attack is occurring?
Flooding the CAM table forces the switch to fail open and behave like a hub, which lets an attacker sniff traffic. DNS poisoning affects name resolution, not switching.
Users who type the correct bank URL are directed to an attacker's server because the recursive resolver holds a forged record. Which control BEST protects against this?
DNSSEC digitally signs DNS records so resolvers can validate their authenticity and integrity. Rate limiting does not verify record authenticity.
After an attacker uses ARP spoofing, all traffic between a workstation and the default gateway passes through the attacker, who reads and alters it. Which attack is this?
The attacker sits between two parties, intercepting and modifying communications, which defines an on-path attack. A replay attack only resends captured traffic.
Which TWO controls help mitigate on-path attacks on a local network?
HTTPS with HSTS and certificate validation
Dynamic ARP inspection blocks forged ARP replies and TLS with certificate validation protects data even if intercepted. Longer passwords do not stop interception.

Travelers at an airport connect to a Wi-Fi network that uses the same SSID as the airline lounge network but with a stronger signal, and a captive page then asks for corporate credentials. What is this attack?
Rogue access point plugged into the wired LAN
An evil twin impersonates a legitimate SSID to harvest credentials. A rogue AP is an unauthorized device connected to the organization's own network.
A wireless scan finds an unmanaged access point connected to a wall jack in a conference room, installed by an employee for convenience. What does this represent?
A rogue AP is an unauthorized AP attached to the internal network, bypassing controls. An evil twin copies an authorized SSID to deceive users.
Wireless clients keep disconnecting, and a capture shows many forged 802.11 management frames that tell clients to leave the network. Which attack is this?
Spoofed deauthentication frames force clients off an AP, often to capture handshakes or push them to an evil twin. Protected management frames (802.11w) help prevent it.
An attacker connects to a victim's phone over Bluetooth without permission and copies the contact list. Which attack is this?
Bluesnarfing steals data over Bluetooth, while bluejacking only sends unsolicited messages.
A server has thousands of half-open TCP connections from spoofed addresses, and legitimate users cannot connect. Which attack is this?
A SYN flood exhausts the connection table by never completing the three-way handshake. SYN cookies are a common mitigation.
Attackers use usernames and passwords leaked from an unrelated website breach to log in to a company's customer portal. Which attack is this?
Credential stuffing reuses known username and password pairs from prior breaches. Password spraying tries a few common passwords across many accounts.
An endpoint scanner finds nothing, yet the system hides its own processes and files and survives reboots by modifying low-level OS components. Which malware type is MOST likely?
Rootkits operate with elevated privileges to conceal their presence from tools running in the OS. Worms are defined by self-replication across networks.
An attacker poses as a new external auditor in person and convinces a receptionist to share a list of server room badge holders. Which social engineering technique is this?
Pretexting uses a fabricated scenario and identity to obtain information. Whaling is phishing aimed at senior executives.
A user logged in to an online bank visits another site, and a hidden request on that page triggers a funds transfer using the user's active session. Which attack is this?
CSRF abuses the browser's existing authenticated session to send unwanted requests. XSS injects script into a trusted page rather than forging cross-site requests.
Which control BEST prevents SQL injection in a web application?
Parameterized queries with server-side input validation
Parameterized queries separate code from data so input cannot alter the SQL statement. Client-side checks can be bypassed.
A malicious update is delivered through a legitimate vendor's signed software distribution channel to thousands of customers. Which threat is this?
Compromising a trusted supplier to reach downstream customers is a supply chain attack. A watering hole targets a site its victims visit.
A user logs in from Pune and 20 minutes later logs in from Frankfurt. What is this MOST likely an indicator of?
Normal use of the corporate proxy
Impossible travel strongly suggests the credentials are being used by someone else. Normal causes are less likely to explain two distant locations in minutes.
An attacker exploits a flaw that the software vendor does not yet know about, and no patch exists. What type of vulnerability is this?
A zero-day is unknown to the vendor and has no patch available at the time of exploitation.
An attacker with a stolen password hash file looks up each hash in a large precomputed table of hashes and plaintexts. Which attack is this?
Rainbow tables are precomputed hash lookups, and unique salts defeat them.
A company hosts a public web server and wants an internal LAN to remain protected if the web server is compromised. Where should the server be placed?
In a screened subnet between two firewalls
Outside the perimeter firewall with no filtering
In the same VLAN as the domain controllers
On the internal LAN with a host firewall
A screened subnet (DMZ) isolates public-facing systems so a compromise does not provide direct access to internal resources.

A firewall ruleset is processed top-down: (1) Allow TCP 443 any to web server, (2) Deny any any, (3) Allow TCP 22 from 10.1.1.0/24 to management server. Administrators on 10.1.1.0/24 cannot SSH to the management server. What is the cause?
Rule 2 matches the SSH traffic before rule 3 is evaluated
Firewalls apply the first matching rule, so the deny-all rule placed above the SSH allow rule blocks it. Moving the allow rule above the deny fixes the problem.
A firewall has only two allow rules: TCP 80 and TCP 443 to a web server. A user tries to connect to the server on TCP 8080. What happens?
The traffic is dropped by the implicit deny rule
The firewall asks the user to authenticate
The traffic is allowed because the destination is permitted
The traffic is redirected to TCP 80
Traffic that matches no rule is denied by the implicit deny at the end of the ruleset.
Which firewall rule BEST permits the 10.0.5.0/24 network to use SFTP to reach a file server at 10.0.9.10 while following least privilege?
Allow any protocol from 10.0.5.0/24 to any
SFTP runs over SSH on TCP 22. UDP 69 is TFTP and TCP 21 is plain FTP control.
A branch office and headquarters gateways need a VPN that encrypts the entire original IP packet, including its header, and adds a new outer header. Which IPsec mode is this?
Tunnel mode encapsulates the whole original packet and is typical for gateway-to-gateway VPNs. Transport mode protects only the payload and keeps the original header.
Contractors on unmanaged laptops need to reach a few internal web applications through a browser without installing any software. Which solution is BEST?
Open the applications directly to the internet
Full-tunnel IPsec with an installed client
A clientless SSL/TLS VPN provides browser-based access over HTTPS. A site-to-site tunnel connects networks, not individual contractors.
In an 802.1X deployment, which component is the switch port that relays authentication messages between the client and the RADIUS server?
The network access device (switch or AP) is the authenticator, the client is the supplicant, and RADIUS is the authentication server.
Which switch feature BEST mitigates MAC flooding by limiting the number of MAC addresses learned on an access port?
Port security caps allowed MAC addresses per port and can shut down or restrict the port on violation.
A rogue DHCP server on a user VLAN hands out an attacker's address as the default gateway. Which feature prevents this?
DHCP snooping permits server responses only on trusted ports, discarding offers from untrusted access ports.
Which security property does DNSSEC provide?
Encryption of DNS queries for confidentiality
Origin authentication and integrity of DNS data
DNSSEC signs records so they can be validated, but it does not encrypt queries. DoH or DoT provide confidentiality.
An application must query a directory service over an encrypted connection using the standard secure LDAP port. Which port should be used?
LDAPS uses TCP 636. TCP 389 is unencrypted LDAP by default, 88 is Kerberos and 3389 is RDP.
A network team wants to monitor devices with both authentication and encryption of management data. Which version of SNMP should be used?
SNMP with a community string of private
SNMPv3 adds user-based authentication and encryption. Versions 1 and 2c send community strings in cleartext.
Which TWO protocols transmit credentials in cleartext and should be blocked at the perimeter in favor of secure alternatives?
Telnet and FTP send usernames and passwords unencrypted. SSH, SFTP and LDAPS are encrypted.
An IDS needs to see a copy of traffic without sitting in the data path or risking an outage if it fails. Which method is BEST?
A network TAP or SPAN port
Using NAT to route traffic through it
Placing it in the screened subnet as a gateway
A TAP or SPAN port provides a passive copy of traffic, so the sensor failing does not interrupt production.
A database server needs storage that survives the failure of any single disk while still offering good read performance and efficient capacity use. Which RAID level is the BEST fit?
RAID 5 stripes data with distributed parity and tolerates one disk failure. RAID 0 has no redundancy.
Before deploying access points in a new warehouse, an engineer wants to determine optimal AP placement and identify coverage gaps. What should be performed?
A penetration test of the SSID
A vulnerability scan of the APs
A wireless site survey with a heat map
A site survey with heat maps shows signal strength and interference so APs can be placed for coverage.
A scan shows TCP 3389 reachable from the internet on a production server. What is the BEST remediation?
Remove direct exposure and require access through a VPN or RD Gateway with MFA
Change the port to 3390 on the same public IP
Share the RDP password only with administrators
RDP should not be directly exposed. Placing it behind a VPN or gateway with MFA reduces attack surface, while changing ports is only obscurity.
Network devices send logs to a central collector over UDP 514, and the security team needs encrypted, reliable delivery. Which is the BEST solution?
Syslog over TLS (TCP 6514) provides confidentiality and reliable transport. Plain UDP syslog is unencrypted and may drop messages.
A mail client is configured to use implicit TLS for both retrieving and sending email. Which port pair is correct for IMAPS and SMTPS?
IMAPS uses TCP 993 and SMTPS commonly uses TCP 465. Ports 143, 25 and 110 are cleartext by default.
Which protocol provides secure file transfer through an SSH subsystem on TCP 22?
SFTP runs over SSH on a single port. FTPS wraps FTP in TLS and uses additional ports.
Firewall logs show one external IP receiving denies for sequential TCP ports on a single host within seconds. What does this MOST likely indicate?
Sequential connection attempts to many ports are the signature of a port scan used to enumerate services.
In the incident response lifecycle, which phase normally follows containment?
After containment limits the damage, eradication removes the root cause such as malware, followed by recovery.
A SOC is overwhelmed by SIEM alerts that investigation shows are benign. What is the BEST action?
Stop collecting logs from noisy sources
Tune the correlation rules and thresholds to reduce false positives
Disable all alerting during business hours
Tuning improves detection quality without losing visibility. Disabling log sources or alerts creates blind spots.
Which data source BEST shows traffic volumes and communicating hosts across the network without storing full packet payloads?
NetFlow summarizes conversations such as source, destination, ports and byte counts with far less storage than full capture.
Which factor should MOST increase the remediation priority of a vulnerability?
It was published over a year ago
It is actively exploited in the wild on an internet-facing system
Active exploitation and exposure drive real risk, so they take priority over age or vendor reputation.
Which authentication protocol uses tickets issued by a key distribution center and runs on port 88?
Kerberos uses a KDC to issue tickets for single sign-on in Active Directory environments.
Network engineers need device administration AAA that encrypts the entire payload and allows per-command authorization on routers. Which protocol is BEST?
TACACS+ separates authentication, authorization and accounting and supports command-level authorization. RADIUS encrypts only the password.
Users report being flooded with MFA push requests until someone approves one. Which control BEST mitigates this?
Number matching requires the user to enter a value shown at the login screen, making blind approvals ineffective.
Administrators check out shared privileged account credentials from a secure repository that rotates them after each use. Which solution is this?
A PAM vault controls, logs and rotates privileged credentials. SSO does not manage shared secrets.
Which email authentication mechanism uses a cryptographic signature in the message header so receivers can verify the message was not altered and came from the domain?
DKIM signs outgoing messages with a domain key published in DNS. SPF only checks the sending IP address.
Before deploying a critical OS patch to all production servers, what should be done FIRST?
Test it in a non-production environment
Testing in staging validates compatibility and avoids widespread outages.
Which backup strategy keeps three copies of data on two different media types with one copy stored off-site?
The 3-2-1 rule describes three copies, two media types and one off-site copy.
An employee leaves the company, but their accounts remain active for months. Which control BEST addresses this?
Automated deprovisioning triggered by the HR system
Tying account removal to HR events removes orphaned accounts quickly and consistently.
Litigation is reasonably anticipated against a company. What should be issued to ensure relevant emails are not deleted?
A legal hold suspends normal deletion so relevant information is preserved for e-discovery.
Which control prevents users from resolving domains known to host malware or phishing sites?
DNS filtering blocks or sinkholes lookups for malicious domains before a connection is made.
A device attached to a SPAN port analyzes traffic and generates alerts but cannot stop malicious packets. What is it?
A passive device that only alerts is an IDS. An IPS sits inline and can block traffic.
Which TWO log sources would BEST help investigate suspected data exfiltration over the web?
Badge reader logs for the server room
Proxy logs show destinations and volumes of web requests and NetFlow shows outbound conversations. The others do not show network data movement.
Which TWO pairs correctly map an insecure protocol to a secure replacement?
SSH replaces Telnet and HTTPS replaces HTTP. TFTP is also insecure and SNMPv1 is weaker than v3.
An endpoint contacts the same unknown external IP address every 60 seconds, including at night. What does this MOST likely indicate?
Regular, automated check-ins to an unfamiliar host are typical of malware beaconing to a C2 server.
Which incident response activity reviews what went well and poorly to improve future handling?
Lessons learned occurs after recovery and feeds improvements into the plan and controls.
A company buys phones, allows employees limited personal use, and enforces its own security policies. Which deployment model is this?
Corporate-owned, personally enabled devices are owned and controlled by the organization with personal use allowed.
A single loss expectancy is $50,000 and the annualized rate of occurrence is 0.2. What is the annualized loss expectancy?
ALE equals SLE multiplied by ARO, so 50,000 x 0.2 = $10,000.
The cost of mitigating a low-impact risk far exceeds the potential loss, and management formally acknowledges it. Which risk strategy is this?
Acceptance is a documented decision to live with a risk when mitigation is not cost-effective.
A workshop rates each risk as high, medium or low based on expert opinion rather than monetary values. Which analysis type is this?
Qualitative analysis uses subjective ratings. Quantitative uses figures such as SLE and ALE.
Which activity is an example of passive reconnaissance during a penetration test?
Searching public WHOIS and DNS records
Passive reconnaissance gathers information without interacting with target systems.
A penetration tester is given only the company name and no network details. Which type of test is this?
A tester with no prior information is performing an unknown environment (black box) test.
Which metric represents the average time required to repair a failed component and restore it to service?
MTTR measures repair time. MTBF measures the average time between failures.
Incident response staff gather to discuss how they would respond to a hypothetical ransomware scenario without touching any systems. What is this exercise?
Tabletop exercises are discussion-based walk-throughs of a scenario.
A company shares confidential product plans with a potential vendor during evaluation. Which agreement BEST prevents disclosure?
An NDA legally restricts disclosure of confidential information.
Which activity should be completed BEFORE signing a contract with a new vendor that will handle sensitive customer data?
Annual penetration test of the vendor
Due diligence evaluates a vendor's security posture before the relationship starts.
Under GDPR, within what time frame must a controller notify the supervisory authority after becoming aware of a reportable personal data breach?
GDPR requires notification within 72 hours where feasible.
Which standard governs organizations that store, process or transmit payment card data?
PCI DSS is the industry standard for cardholder data. HIPAA covers health information.
Which governance document provides detailed step-by-step instructions for completing a specific task, such as onboarding a new user account?
Procedures give step-by-step instructions, while policies state high-level intent.
In a data governance model, which role makes the final decision on how sensitive a particular business dataset is?
The data owner is accountable for classification and access decisions. A custodian carries out technical protection.
What is the primary purpose of a clean desk policy?
Reduce exposure of sensitive information left unattended
Clearing papers and media from desks reduces risk of theft or viewing of sensitive material.
An organization needs an independent party to assess its controls so it can obtain a formal certification. Which type of audit is needed?
Certification generally requires an independent external auditor.
Which term describes the acceptable level of variation around an organization's risk appetite?
Risk tolerance sets boundaries around the appetite. Residual risk remains after controls are applied.
A company invites independent researchers to report vulnerabilities in its applications in exchange for rewards. What is this program called?
Bug bounty programs reward external researchers for responsibly disclosed vulnerabilities.
Which TWO are rights granted to data subjects under GDPR?
Right of access to their data
Right to unlimited retention of data by the controller
Right to modify the controller's encryption keys
Right to audit the controller's source code
GDPR grants individuals access and portability rights, among others. The remaining options are not GDPR rights.
